intent.proves: Every active direct member of an account carries the account's customer number, which the frontend relies on.
intent.scope: direct members of account groups; complete enumeration; at least one member must be enumerated

bindings.reason: The tool answers one subject id at a time; a whole-host count needs a per-subject enumeration handler that is not implemented.

bindings.query: SELECT u.AccessUserId, g.AccessUserId AS AccountId FROM AccessUserGroupRelation r JOIN AccessUser g ON g.AccessUserId = r.AccessUserGroupRelationGroupId JOIN AccessUser u ON u.AccessUserId = r.AccessUserGroupRelationUserId WHERE g.AccessUserType = 2 AND g.AccessUserUserAndGroupType = 'SystemAccount' AND u.AccessUserType <> 2 AND u.AccessUserActive = 1 AND ISNULL(u.AccessUserCustomerNumber,'') <> ISNULL(g.AccessUserCustomerNumber,'')
